faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by CSK Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV) for filling up research positions in Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under Advt No 05/2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow under the Bioversity International project, offering exciting opportunities for qualified life sciences professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position under this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in any discipline of life sciences along with a valid NET qualification from ICAR, UGC, or CSIR.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend provided for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) of Rs. 300/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for CSKHPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Eligible candidates must submit their filled applications on plain paper along with required bank drafts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form along with the necessary fee processing details is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the work specific interaction scheduled for applicants?
faq.answer: The work specific interaction or selection process for eligible candidates who have applied is scheduled to take place on 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for general and reserved categories?
faq.answer: General category candidates are required to pay Rs. 450/-, while candidates belonging to reserved categories need to pay Rs. 110/- as processing fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official CSKHPKV website at www.hillagric.ac.in to access the notification details and download the necessary application documents.
